info.title: FieldLoop internal mock ILI report drop
info.description: Synthetic read-only simulator endpoint from architecture section 4.2. Not a web-api/BFF endpoint. Run behind Cloud Run invoker IAM in dev/demo; local reads need no credentials. The same document is the file placed in the environment's ILI drop bucket by Terraform; this service neither reads nor writes that bucket. Arrival is announced to the platform only as a signal.v1 message published in process.

get.description: Return one deterministic synthetic in-line inspection report for DL-01, byte-for-byte the document that is dropped in the bucket. No source write, database, publisher or remote IO.

405.description: Only GET is served, so every other method is refused; code method_not_allowed, and Allow names the methods the path serves. No state mutation.

serviceIdentity.description: Verified by Cloud Run invoker IAM, not proxy headers. The handler does not implement browser auth or independently validate IAM.
